tytul: Fermented cornelian cherries in olive oil: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for cornelian cherries that are fermented and then kept in olive oil: JarAtlas has no recipe for them from a checked source.

ostrzezenia.tekst: There are no validated processes for vegetables and herbs in oil made at home; in the USA, the rules for such products apply only to commercial processors.
Appearance, smell and taste cannot tell you whether vegetables in oil carry a botulism hazard.

akapity: JarAtlas found no checked source with a home method for fruit in oil, so it applies the same caution as for vegetables in oil.
JarAtlas also has no checked recipe for fermenting cornelian cherries before they go into the oil.
